headline: Star Housing Finance director ceases office
summary: Amlendra Prasad Saxena ceased to be an Independent Director of Star Housing Finance Ltd on October 23, 2026, after completing his tenure.

headline: BHEL appoints two senior management heads
summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd appointed Rajeeva Srivastava and Amit Gupta as heads of International Operations and Defence & Aerospace Business Group respectively, effective October 25, 2026.

headline: NIIT Learning to host Q2FY27 earnings call
summary: NIIT Learning Systems Limited will host an investor call on October 29, 2026, to discuss unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Fratelli Vineyards sets rights issue price
summary: Fratelli Vineyards will decide the issue price and ratio for its ₹30 crore rights issue on October 26, 2026.

headline: BCCL Q2FY27 PAT turns positive at ₹124 crore
summary: Bharat Coking Coal Limited reported a standalone net profit of ₹123.74 crore in Q2FY27, reversing the previous quarter's loss. Revenue rose 39% YoY to ₹4,412.58 crore.

headline: RailTel Q2FY27 Results: PAT down 10% YoY
summary: RailTel Corporation of India Limited reported a 10% YoY decline in net profit to ₹6,856 lakh for Q2FY27. Revenue rose 20% to ₹1,14,614 lakh. Board declared ₹1 interim dividend.

headline: Arvind Ltd opens ₹150 crore garment plant in Varanasi
summary: Arvind Limited inaugurated a new greenfield garment manufacturing facility in Varanasi with a ₹150 crore investment. The plant aims to generate over 1,000 jobs and boost vertical integration.

headline: Senco Gold acquires 68% stake in Melorra for ₹68 crore
summary: Senco Gold executes SSA to acquire 68% equity in August Jewellery Private Limited (Melorra) for ₹68 crore, aiming to strengthen its digital and omnichannel strategy.

headline: Crescentis Capital to decide rights issue terms
summary: Crescentis Capital Ltd board meeting on Oct 29, 2026, to approve rights issue terms. BSE granted in-principle listing approval. Fund raise up to ₹80 crore.

headline: IIFL Finance director tenure ends
summary: T S Ramakrishnan's tenure as LIC nominee director at IIFL Finance concludes on October 25, 2026, per SEBI disclosure.

headline: Konndor Industries appoints Pooja Goyal as Director
summary: Konndor Industries Limited appointed Ms. Pooja Arvind Goyal as a Director during a board meeting held on November 3, 2026. The appointment was formally intimated to BSE Ltd.

headline: Netripples Software gets clean audit for FY22
summary: Netripples Software Limited received an unmodified audit opinion from BGS & Associates for FY22. The auditor confirmed compliance with statutory dues and internal controls.
